resources.string: On your receiving phone, open MediaSync and tap Add sending phone. Then scan the code it shows.
MediaSync sends your photos and videos to %1$s. It needs access to all of them, and to the places they were taken so locations stay in your backup.
%1$s has all your photos and videos.

plurals.name: producer_status_pending_body
plurals.item: Tap Sync now to send it to %1$s.
Tap Sync now to send them to %1$s.

resources.string: Both phones need to be on the same Wi-Fi, with MediaSync open.
Couldn\'t find %1$s. Check that both phones are on the same Wi-Fi and MediaSync is open on it.
Couldn\'t reach %1$s, over Wi-Fi or the internet. Open MediaSync on it, or wait for its scheduled sync.
The connection to %1$s dropped. Nothing is lost: the next sync continues where this one stopped.
%1$s no longer recognises this phone. Pair them again.
%1$s runs a different MediaSync version. Update the app on both phones.
The sync planned for %1$s didn\'t run
This phone wasn\'t on Wi-Fi. It tries again while charging.
%1$s couldn\'t be found on the Wi-Fi. This phone tries again while charging.
The connection to %1$s dropped. This phone tries again while charging and continues where it stopped.
This phone was too warm. It tries again once it has cooled down.
The battery was below 20%. This phone tries again once it has charged more.
Android may have paused MediaSync to save battery. In MediaSync\'s settings, open the battery settings and choose Unrestricted.

Syncs run while this phone is charging, so leave it plugged in, e.g. overnight. If it was charging, the phone\'s battery saver may have stopped MediaSync: allow it to run in the background in the phone\'s battery settings.

plurals.name: producer_waiting_for_space_body
plurals.item: %1$d photo or video is waiting. It\'s sent once there\'s space on %2$s.
%1$d photos and videos are waiting. They\'re sent once there\'s space on %2$s.

resources.string: Locations won\'t be included in your photos until you allow MediaSync to read them.
Sync now reaches %1$s while MediaSync is open on it, or during its scheduled sync.
Syncs whenever this phone is charging and has new photos.
Syncs only when you tap Sync now.
Choose which folders to send to %1$s.
Photos and videos carry details: where they were taken, which phone took them, captions. Choose what this phone sends to %1$s.
Photos and videos carry details: where they were taken, which phone took them, captions. Choose what this phone sends.
Photos and videos arrive exactly as they are on this phone.
Places are removed: GPS, place names and video location. Everything else stays.
Location, camera, phone, captions, album and favorite are removed. The date, orientation and colours stay.
Motion Photos and Ultra HDR photos arrive as ordinary photos. RAW photos aren\'t sent: their details can\'t be removed.
Applies to photos and videos sent from now on. Those already sent keep their details.
MediaSync can\'t remove the details of RAW photos and some other files. Choose another Photo details setting to send them.
Sends straight to %1$s over a direct Wi-Fi link, without the router. Faster for big backlogs. Keep the two phones close together.
The battery is low: plug this phone in, as Turbo uses more power.
Turn on location first: before Android 13, direct Wi-Fi links need it. MediaSync doesn\'t use your location.
Turbo needs permission to connect to nearby devices (location, before Android 13). Allow it in MediaSync\'s settings.
Linking the two phones directly. This takes a few seconds.
%1$s used: until next month, syncs wait for Wi-Fi
When the phones can\'t connect directly, Cloudflare\'s relay carries what\'s sent. Off: videos wait for Wi-Fi or a direct connection, to spare the free allowance.
Through the relay, only photos went, to spare its free allowance. Videos go over Wi-Fi or a direct connection, or turn on Send videos through the relay.
Away from Wi-Fi, photos and videos go to %1$s over the internet. Off: only over Wi-Fi networks, to spare your data plan.
%1$s wasn\'t found, on this Wi-Fi or directly. On %1$s, open MediaSync and tap Turbo receive, then try again here.
%1$s isn\'t on this Wi-Fi. For Turbo away from a shared Wi-Fi, the two phones need to sync once on the same Wi-Fi first.
%1$s can\'t do Turbo transfer: it has no Wi-Fi Direct. Everything went over Wi-Fi instead.
Turbo needs your OK on %1$s: open MediaSync there and allow it to connect to nearby devices. Then try again. Meanwhile, everything went over Wi-Fi.
The direct link to %1$s didn\'t connect, so everything went over Wi-Fi. Keep the phones close together and try again.
The direct link to %1$s dropped, so the rest went over Wi-Fi.
Photos and videos in these folders are sent to your receiving phone. Turning a folder off doesn\'t remove what it already received.
Matching folders added later are included automatically.
Only the folders you check are sent.
No photos or videos on this phone yet.
